subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Should maintainers treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as the canonical shared fix for this issue, or ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 to be refreshed as the issue-specific PR?
rationale: The issue is valid and source-reproducible, but overlapping open PRs have different freshness and scope, so cleanup should not queue another fix or close this issue before maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Use current-file shared PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as canonical, have it explicitly reference this issue, and require its remaining proof and CI gaps before closing the issue.

options.title: Refresh direct PR
options.body: Ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 to rebase or port from the old `pi-*` files if maintainers prefer the reporter's direct issue-specific branch.

options.title: Split Feishu residuals
options.body: Keep this issue scoped to the read-image bridge while leaving direct Feishu `MEDIA:` and fallback-security residuals to narrower Feishu follow-ups.

recommendation.title: Use current-file shared PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as canonical, have it explicitly reference this issue, and require its remaining proof and CI gaps before closing the issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared media pipeline history makes this the best available owner for selecting the canonical landing path.
